notes.title: Join our Discord Server!
notes.content:
Many of you have been asking if we have a Discord for the game, so we decided to create one for us all to chat! To join, click the link below.

[url=https://discord.gg/7nx2VRK]Join our Discord[/url]

We hope to see a bunch of you in there!

notes.title: Alpha Testing Sign-Up!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! For anyone interested in Alpha Testing the game, you can [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdqW_EqpJ4ZAj6ggrnPTjHTSlllP6Qv7ZZbONl3hgPivFIn3g/viewform?usp=sf_link]sign up here.[/url]

We're currently preparing the environment and matchmaking logic to be played with you guys, and we're super excited to join you in the fight!
